title: Less Than Equal Constraints
bullets: x₁ ≤ z₁ , x₂ ≤ z₂ , x₃ ≤ z₃
x₁ ≥ z₁ , x₂ ≥ z₂ , x₃ ≥ z₃

layout.arrangement: Light-gray slide field inside one outer red rectangular frame. Centered red bold title across the top; yellow circular badge '6' upper-right. Below the title, 3 stacked horizontal red-bordered rows of equal width. Each row contains a left constraint line, a green right arrow, and a matrix-inequality diagram: row 1 '3 constraints' with identity-matrix inequality and right-side 'G x ≤ h' pill; row 2 greater-than constraints converted to a −I matrix inequality plus pale-yellow 'Convert' note box at right; row 3 '6 constraints, 3 variables' with 6×3 matrix inequality, a '6 x 3' tag, and right-side 'G x ≤ h' pill.

visual_elements.detail: bracketed 3x3 identity, column vector x, ≤, column vector z
bracketed 3x3 (−I), column vector x, ≤, column vector −z
bracketed 6x3 matrix, column vector x, ≤, column vector (−y,z); '6 x 3' tag at [0.558,0.862,0.600,0.898]

typography_notes: Sans-serif (Calibri-like). Title bold ~32 pt centered title case. Row labels ~14 pt bold red underlined; '6 constraints, 3 variables' also italic. Math ~14 pt, variables italic color-coded, numerals upright, subscripts lowered. Pills 'G x ≤ h' bold ~16 pt red centered in salmon pill. Badge '6' bold ~14 pt black. '6 x 3' ~9 pt dark.
